source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: Whenever an enemy unit, other than a **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** unit, is picked to [Fall Back](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back) while in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of any of your units with this ability, each of its models takes a [Desperate Escape test](vsdata:core-rule/desperate-escape) as though the unit were [battle-shocked](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock). If the enemy unit is battle-shocked for another reason too, each of those tests gets -1.
